description: React component for selecting teams in the Mattermost admin console, with async loading and search capabilities.

methods.name: loadListInPageNumber
methods.description: Loads a page of team options from the server and updates the list state.

methods.name: searchInList
methods.description: Searches for teams matching a search term via server API.

methods.name: handleMenuScrolledToBottom
methods.description: Loads more teams when the user scrolls to the bottom of the menu.

methods.name: handleOnChange
methods.description: Handles selection change, updating state and calling parent callback.
